question: Which of the following is NOT classified as a Central Public Sector Enterprise?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Macroratna**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term **"Macroratna"** is **not an officially recognized classification** of Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) in India.
 
• The classifications for CPSEs that are commonly recognized include **Navaratna**, **Maharatna**, and **Miniratna**.
 
• Common Classifications of CPSEs:
 
 
• Navaratna: A designation for certain CPSEs that have demonstrated good financial performance and are granted enhanced autonomy to promote efficiency.
 
• Maharatna: This is the highest status given to CPSEs, allowing them significant financial and operational autonomy.
 
 
• These companies can invest substantial amounts without prior government approval.
 
 
 
• Miniratna: These are smaller public sector enterprises with some level of autonomy, but their financial capabilities and operational scope are more limited than those of Navaratna and Maharatna companies.
